tagline: Diversified industrial manufacturer with leading positions in products and services across commercial and industrial markets, focused on growth through strategic acquisitions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Standex pursues an active acquisition strategy to expand its presence in high-growth and high-margin markets, particularly in the electrical grid sector and India. These acquisitions constitute a key driver of revenue growth.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales of goods and services after deductions.
kpis.description: Net sales increased 9.6% for fiscal year 2025 compared to the prior year, primarily driven by significant acquisitions that contributed $123.6 million, while organic sales declined 7.5%.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by acquisitions and partially offset by organic declines.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deduction of cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin increased to 39.9% for fiscal year 2025, compared to 39.1% in the prior year, supported by productivity gains, positive impact from acquisitions and volume growth, partially offset by raw material inflation.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement driven by volume growth and productivity initiatives.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating income declined to $93.5 million in 2025, impacted by increased acquisition-related expenses ($21.4M) and integration of acquired entities, notably higher SG&A spending.
kpis.signal: Operating income decline due to increased acquisition expenses and SG&A costs related to integration.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of customer orders not yet delivered or invoiced, realizable within 12 months.
kpis.description: Backlog realizable within the year reached $245.6 million in 2025, an increase of 32.5% compared to the prior year ($185.3M), reflecting robust future demand.
kpis.signal: Strong backlog growth, indicating robust future demand.

kpis.name: Acquisition related expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs directly associated with the acquisition process of other companies, including acquisition fees, integration and professional fees.
kpis.description: Acquisition-related expenses increased significantly in 2025, reaching $21.4 million (compared to $2.6M in 2024), due to completion of several major acquisitions including Amran/Narayan Group, Custom Biogenic Systems, Nascent Technology Manufacturing and McStarlite.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in acquisition-related expenses, reflecting an active external growth strategy.

kpis.name: SG&A as % of Sales
kpis.explanation: Selling, general and administrative costs expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses represented 24.5% of revenue in 2025 ($193.4M), up from 23.5% in the prior year ($169.9M), primarily reflecting integration of recent acquisitions, increased R&D and sales spending.
kpis.signal: SG&A expense increase due to acquisition integration and increased R&D efforts.

kpis.name: Restructuring Costs
kpis.explanation: Expenses incurred to reorganize the company to improve efficiency, including plant closures, relocations and workforce reductions.
kpis.description: Restructuring costs totaled $6.9 million in 2025 (compared to $8.2M in 2024), primarily related to facility rationalization and cost structure optimization efforts.
kpis.signal: Restructuring costs declined compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.056B in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Acquisition - Amran/Narayan Group
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Amran/Narayan Group to expand presence in the electrical market and India with a combined enterprise value.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Amran/Narayan Group for $467.5 million (85% cash and 15% Standex stock for Amran Instrument Transformers, 90% cash and 10% stock for Narayan Powertech) aims to significantly expand the company's presence in the fast-growing, high-margin electrical grid market and increase international presence in India.
kpis.signal: Major strategic acquisition to strengthen position in the high-growth electrical grid market and increase international presence in India.

kpis.name: Acquisition - Custom Biogenic Systems
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Custom Biogenic Systems to expand offerings in cryogenic equipment for life sciences and pharmaceutical markets.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Custom Biogenic Systems (announced November 14, 2024) strengthens Standex's presence in the life sciences sector by developing and manufacturing advanced cryogenic equipment, including unique isothermal freezers with dry liquid nitrogen technology, for pharmaceutical and biobank markets.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into the life sciences and pharmaceutical sector with specialized and unique cryogenic equipment.

risks.title: Economic deterioration and inflation
risks.score_rationale: The risk is positioned at the beginning of the section with strong language (adversely affect, materially increase) and covers both inflation and recession. It impacts several key drivers (demand, margins, competitiveness). The Macro category is highly weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on credit facilities
risks.score_rationale: The risk covers dependence on credit for operations and strategic acquisitions, fundamental to growth. Recent acquisitions (Amran/Narayan, McStarlite) utilize existing credit facilities. Alarming language regarding potential impacts if credit access is restricted.

risks.title: Increased competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned multiple times with direct link to margins and market share. Repeated language on difficulty maintaining prices against lower-cost competitors, particularly in low-inflation areas.

risks.title: Raw material scarcity and volatility
risks.score_rationale: Risk concerning critical inputs (steel, aluminum, rare elements) with price volatility and inability to fully hedge. Direct impact on profits if not offset by selling prices. High position in risk factors text.

ai_positioning.summary: Standex integrates advanced technologies in its products serving various industrial markets. Although the text does not explicitly mention generative AI, recent acquisitions in defense, advanced cryogenic equipment and high-reliability magnetic components suggest an orientation toward critical and highly specialized technologies.
evidence: Acquisition of Nascent Technology Manufacturing, which designs and manufactures high-reliability magnetic components for critical defense and industrial applications.
Acquisition of McStarlite Co., a leading supplier of complex aerospace sheet metal components (February 2025).
Acquisition of Custom Biogenic Systems, specialized in development and manufacturing of advanced cryogenic equipment with proprietary technology for pharmaceutical and biobank markets.
